authority: Owner-approved supplement to the canonical Decision Ledger

decisions.decision: Use black (#000000) badge text in Light and white (#FFFFFF) in Dark for all shot-style, Dialed In, pending and admin badges. Preserve exact original JSX dark badge fills in both themes and existing defined borders.
decisions.accessibility_note: Raw text/fill pairs sometimes fall short of 4.5:1. Previously proposed halos are superseded by VISUAL-BADGES-CLEAN-03, in favor of crisp lettering with no text effects. No independent WCAG audit is claimed.
preserved: Sensory taste chip colors and behavior
Recommendation calculations and all backend/data/security decisions
decisions.release_hold: Screenshots and owner approval required before Netlify release.

decisions.decision: Remove all badge lettering shadows, halos, strokes, and background overlays in both Light and Dark. Retain plain black text in Light, plain white text in Dark, original JSX dark badge fills in both modes, and distinct solid badge borders.
preserves: No impact on app data, engine, account privacy, or other Locked decisions
decisions.accessibility_note: Some badge text/solid fill combinations have insufficient raw WCAG contrast. Do not imply compliance; investigate legibility alternatives with the owner if needed.
decisions.release_hold: Private visual review only; no Netlify publishing without owner approval.
